description: Fork of exp574 (no_resid + tied dot + ln_emb.gamma=0.1 init, ~71.57M/163Mbits, projected ~1.50). TWO coupled changes: embedding_dim E 96->192 AND d_v 16->32. Keeps the architectural invariant H*d_v = E (6*32=192) — out_proj stays square 192->192 (no compression like exp513's quirk). All else identical to exp574 (no residual_lut, no Linear unembedder, tied dot head with separate ln_emb gamma=0.1). Predicted params ~124.26M (+52.7M): tok_emb +3.15M, v_lut +11.80M, out_proj +37.74M (n_out=E grew 2x), LN tiny. Predicted bandwidth ~289 Mbits (+126): tied dot head doubles (E*V*32), out_proj doubles, v_lut doubles. STILL 39% of vanilla 742, 61% of exp567 475. If final lands at <=1.4768 (exp567's loss), exp575 is Pareto-better than exp567 (less bandwidth, similar quality). If <1.45, the design beats tied vanilla on per-bit bandwidth at competitive loss. Refs: exp574 currently ~1.6958 @ step 3000 (running parallel), exp567 1.4768 untied, exp328 tied vanilla 1.3882, exp476 untied vanilla 1.4143.
